scope: Mocked EAS worker pages and regenerated source inventories; no provider or database access

behavior.page_state: Retain the attestation IDs from only the preceding full provider page
behavior.in_page_duplicates: Reject duplicate IDs among the in-scope records before persistence
behavior.adjacent_overlap: Reject an in-scope page that shares an ID with the preceding full page, including a shorter terminal page
behavior.failure_boundary: Do not persist the repeated/overlapping page or advance the recipient cursor; prior page commits remain idempotent

regressions: Consecutive identical full pages fail before the second page write
A shifted full page with one overlapping ID fails before persistence
A shorter terminal page with one overlapping ID fails before persistence
Duplicate attestation IDs within one full page fail before persistence

focused_tests.python_mode: python -s to exclude a broken user-site pytest plugin entrypoint

limitations: No live EAS endpoint, database, candidate, or legacy service was contacted
Adjacent overlap detection cannot identify a missing interval that has no shared ID
Non-adjacent offset cycles, general snapshot instability, and earlier-than-cursor arrivals remain open
Live provider parity and MAN-CAP acceptance remain open
